entries.9de281998a645a3e: The company launched its 6th management plan, covering a 3-year period from April Reiwa 8 to March Reiwa 11. Setting as its vision for 10 years ahead “a wide-area financial group that people say was right to choose Tomoni,” it will work on measures based on 5 basic strategies: sustainability strategy, sales strategy, talent strategy, operations strategy and governance strategy. The group management philosophy consists of “Customer First,” “Growing Together with Customers” and “Management of Trust and Peace of Mind.”

For the fiscal year ended March 2026, ordinary income from external customers was ¥60,233 million from lending operations, ¥20,109 million from securities investment operations, ¥5,873 million from leasing operations and ¥18,558 million from other operations, and consolidated ordinary income was ¥104,775 million. Ordinary income of the 2 bank subsidiaries was ¥54,140 million for Tokushima Taisho Bank and ¥44,168 million for Kagawa Bank. entries.f5b942a9bae8c513: With Tokushima Taisho Bank, headquartered in Tokushima Prefecture, and Kagawa Bank, headquartered in Kagawa Prefecture, as its 2 core banks, it has a wide-area branch network that also includes branches in Osaka Prefecture, Hyogo Prefecture and Tokyo, among others. Consolidated subsidiaries handle leasing, credit cards, venture capital, computer services, credit guarantees, and GX and regional revitalization-related operations, and the company has put in place a structure for providing financial services combined with banking operations within the group.
